package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	workserver "example.com/admission/gen/http/work/server"
	"example.com/admission/gen/work"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/admission"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http/middleware"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type testService struct {
	workService
	calls, checks int
	denied        bool
}

func (s *testService) Run(_ context.Context, payload *work.RunPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	return payload.Message, nil
}

func (s *testService) AuthorizeWorkRun(ctx context.Context) error {
	s.checks++
	if s.denied {
		return loom.PermanentError("forbidden", "permission denied")
	}
	return s.workService.AuthorizeWorkRun(ctx)
}

func TestEarlyRateAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		early := newRate(t, 1, 1)
		service := &testService{workService: workService{secret: "valid"}}
		backendChecks := 0
		handler := quotaHTTP(t, service, early, func(context.Context, string) (admission.RateDecision, error) {
			backendChecks++
			return admission.RateDecision{Allowed: true}, nil
		})
		response := quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"one\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		checks := service.checks
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "bad-key", "{malformed")
		require.Equal(t, 429, response.Code)
		require.Equal(t, "1", response.Header().Get("Retry-After"))
		require.Equal(t, checks, service.checks, "early rejection precedes authentication and decoding")
		require.Equal(t, 1, backendChecks)
		require.Equal(t, 1, service.calls)
		require.NoError(t, early.SetPolicy(admission.RatePolicy{PerSecond: 2, Burst: 2}))
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"two\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 429, response.Code, "an increase must not refill spent allowance")
		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"two\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		require.Equal(t, 2, service.calls)
	})
}

func TestAuthenticatedRateAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		groups := map[string]*admission.Rate{"alpha": newRate(t, 1, 1), "beta": newRate(t, 1, 1)}
		service := &testService{workService: workService{secret: "valid"}}
		backendChecks := 0
		handler := quotaHTTP(t, service, newRate(t, 100, 100), func(ctx context.Context, key string) (admission.RateDecision, error) {
			backendChecks++
			bucket, ok := groups[key]
			require.True(t, ok, "only trusted bounded groups reach the backend")
			return bucket.Allow(ctx)
		})
		for _, tc := range []struct {
			key, body string
			status    int
		}{
			{"valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"\"}", 400},
			{"invalid", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}", 401},
		} {
			response := quotaRequest(handler, tc.key, tc.body)
			require.Equal(t, tc.status, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
		require.Zero(t, backendChecks)
		response := quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 429, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		require.Equal(t, "1", response.Header().Get("Retry-After"))
		require.Contains(t, response.Body.String(), "authenticated quota exhausted")
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-beta", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		require.Equal(t, 2, service.calls)
		checks := backendChecks
		service.denied = true
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 403, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		require.Equal(t, checks, backendChecks, "authorization still precedes an exhausted quota")
		service.denied = false
		policy := admission.RatePolicy{PerSecond: 2, Burst: 4}
		require.NoError(t, groups["alpha"].SetPolicy(policy))
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 429, response.Code)
		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		require.NoError(t, groups["alpha"].SetPolicy(policy))
		response = quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 429, response.Code)
		require.Equal(t, 3, service.calls)
	})
}

func TestRateBackendFailure(t *testing.T) {
	for _, timeout := range []bool{false, true} {
		synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
			service := &testService{workService: workService{secret: "valid"}}
			handler := quotaHTTP(t, service, newRate(t, 100, 100), func(ctx context.Context, _ string) (admission.RateDecision, error) {
				if timeout {
					<-ctx.Done()
					return admission.RateDecision{Allowed: true}, nil
				}
				return admission.RateDecision{}, errors.New("sensitive database and identity")
			})
			response := quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
			require.Equal(t, 503, response.Code, response.Body.String())
			require.Contains(t, response.Body.String(), "rate_limit_unavailable")
			require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "sensitive")
			require.Empty(t, response.Header().Get("Retry-After"))
			require.Zero(t, service.calls)
		})
	}
}

func TestRateAdmissionRetainsProtectedRecheck(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		service := &testService{workService: workService{secret: "valid"}}
		bucket := newRate(t, 1, 1)
		handler := quotaHTTP(t, service, newRate(t, 100, 100), func(ctx context.Context, _ string) (admission.RateDecision, error) {
			decision, err := bucket.Allow(ctx)
			service.denied = true
			return decision, err
		})
		response := quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
		require.Equal(t, 403, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		require.Zero(t, service.calls)
		decision, err := bucket.Allow(context.Background())
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.False(t, decision.Allowed, "later rejection does not refund an accounted attempt")
	})
}

func TestRateUnknownDelayOmitsHeader(t *testing.T) {
	service := &testService{workService: workService{secret: "valid"}}
	handler := quotaHTTP(t, service, newRate(t, 100, 100), func(context.Context, string) (admission.RateDecision, error) {
		return admission.RateDecision{}, nil
	})
	response := quotaRequest(handler, "valid-alpha", "{\"message\":\"ok\"}")
	require.Equal(t, 429, response.Code, response.Body.String())
	require.Empty(t, response.Header().Get("Retry-After"))
	require.Zero(t, service.calls)
}

func newRate(t *testing.T, perSecond float64, burst int) *admission.Rate {
	t.Helper()
	bucket, err := admission.NewRate(admission.RatePolicy{PerSecond: perSecond, Burst: burst})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return bucket
}

func quotaHTTP(t *testing.T, service *testService, bucket *admission.Rate, check admission.RateCheck) http.Handler {
	t.Helper()
	quota, err := admission.NewRateAdmission(check, 10*time.Millisecond)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	early, err := admission.NewRateAdmission(func(ctx context.Context, _ string) (admission.RateDecision, error) {
		return bucket.Allow(ctx)
	}, 10*time.Millisecond)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	endpoints := work.NewEndpoints(service, service)
	endpoints.Use(quota.Middleware(authenticatedGroup, quotaError))
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	workserver.Mount(mux, workserver.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	return middleware.RateLimit(early, func(*http.Request) (string, error) {
		return "process", nil
	})(mux)
}

func quotaRequest(handler http.Handler, key, body string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/work", strings.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("X-API-Key", key)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(response, req)
	return response
}
